data.overview: A charismatic young founder promises a tiny blood sample can transform medical testing, rising to fame as investors rush to join her. When the technology fails to deliver, a trail of warnings reveals how ambition became an elaborate fraud.
data.tagline: A breakthrough built on a drop of doubt.
data.title: The Miracle in the Vial
